mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (name, age, phone, image, password, identity, credit, rname, number, idcard, isworking, timepreference, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{age}, #{phone}, #{image}, #{password}, #{identity}, #{credit}, #{rname}, #{number}, #{idcard}, #{isworking}, #{timepreference}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET name = #{name}, age = #{age}, phone = #{phone}, image = #{image}, password = #{password}, identity = #{identity}, credit = #{credit}, rname = #{rname}, number = #{number}, idcard = #{idcard}, isworking = #{isworking}, timepreference = #{timepreference} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user WHERE phone = #{phone} AND password = #{password}
SELECT * FROM user WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name}) AND password = #{password}
SELECT * FROM user WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name}) LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM user WHERE phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM user WHERE number = #{number} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM user WHERE rname = #{rname} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM user WHERE idcard = #{idcard} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET isworking = #{isworking} WHERE id = #{userId}
